messages:
Zoe Chen: merged engine/quant-rewrite -> staging about an hour ago. Deploybot said success, but the eu-west-1 canary shows a 2-3% p95 latency blip on 512-token gen :eyes:.
Zoe Chen: posting quick smoke snippet from canary traces:
Zoe Chen: ```p95_before=42.0ms
p95_after=43.1ms
count=1200
query_bucket=512_tokens
regression=2.6%```
Lucas Patel: hmm ok. which kernel variant landed? matmul-v2 or the fused-gemm path?
Zoe Chen: landed fused-gemm + new quant packing. build id: qrewrite-20260318-7a9f
DeployBot: deploy success: service=runtime-staging region=eu-west-1 id=qrewrite-20260318-7a9f users=canary(5%)
Kevin Miller: could be cache warming change or kv cache eviction policy different with new packing. Have we seen any error spikes?
Zoe Chen: errors are flat. only latency tail nudged. CPU on cpu-side proxies same. GPU token latency shows small uptick on step 4 of attention.
Ria Singh: note: rollout config used sticky_pin_ttl=24h for this merge (was supposed to be 6h). canary got longer exposure.
Andre Gomez: that TTL mismatch is bad. two quick options: 1) pin back to previous engine build in eu-west-1 (fast), 2) hotpatch small kernel tweak and re-deploy canary (riskier).
Kevin Miller: +1 to pin rollback for immediate mitigation. give us time to bisect.
Lucas Patel: can we do a scoped rollback only in eu-west-1 while leaving other regions alone?
DeployBot: rollback available: /deploy rollback runtime-staging --to qrewrite-20260310-f3d2 --region eu-west-1 --dry-run=false
Zoe Chen: I'll trigger the rollback if we all agree. we should also open a quick bisect PR to isolate fused-gemm vs packing.
Ria Singh: also re: release notes, there's a short blurb template under docs/releases/engine — I'll start a stub and tag eng-runtime.
Andre Gomez: small mitigation attempt: reduce continuous-batching window from 20ms -> 10ms in staging for that build and rerun canary, might mask tail. but that's a config-level test, not a real kernel fix.
Kevin Miller: prefer rollback + config test. rollback will stop customer exposure. then we run ab tests with config change and re-run perf harness.
Zoe Chen: action list: (1) Ria create release note stub + link to perf traces, (2) Zoe initiate region-scoped rollback to qrewrite-20260310-f3d2 in eu-west-1 now, (3) Andre open bisect PR and try the reduced batch window in parallel, (4) Kevin run perf harness against both builds.
Ria Singh: creating stub: https://internal.docs/releases/engine/qrewrite-20260318-draft (adding perf charts) :+1:
DeployBot: executing rollback: region=eu-west-1 from=qrewrite-20260318-7a9f to=qrewrite-20260310-f3d2 user=Zoe Chen
DeployBot: rollback complete, new canary now at qrewrite-20260310-f3d2 in eu-west-1.
sre-bot: alert: p95 latency back to baseline in eu-west-1. closed incident if no further regressions in 30m.
Zoe Chen: thanks team. we'll keep the staging build pinned and schedule a morning convo to triage the fused-gemm change before any further rollout.
Lucas Patel: logging a followup to eng-runtime board for kernel ABI/packing checklist.
Kevin Miller: I'll run the perf suite and post results in this thread in ~20 mins.
Andre Gomez: opening bisect PR now. tagging you all.
Ria Singh: release note stub updated with rollback note and next steps.
Zoe Chen: closing loop — reopen if any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
